meta.name: performance-profiling
meta.description: Profile and optimize application performance. Use when asked to improve speed, reduce latency, fix memory leaks, find bottlenecks, or optimize a slow function or endpoint.

copy.tagline: 分析并优化应用性能，提升速度降低延迟
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果应用响应慢、内存泄漏或需要定位性能瓶颈
copy.tagline_en: Profile and optimize application performance to improve speed and reduce latency
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your app is slow, has memory leaks, or needs bottleneck analysis

howto.what: Claude会先测量函数耗时、端点延迟或内存占用，然后分析性能工具的输出，找出耗时最多的前3个函数，仅对第一个瓶颈提出最小改动，再测量改进百分比，重复直到性能达标。
howto.when: 当用户要求提高速度、减少延迟、修复内存泄漏、找出瓶颈或优化慢函数/端点时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个Python函数的性能瓶颈。
say.note: Claude会进行性能分析并给出优化建议。

say.text: 优化这个API端点，降低P99延迟。
say.note: Claude会测量延迟并提出改进。

say.text: 找出这段代码的内存泄漏。
say.note: Claude会记录内存使用并分析。

howto.what_en: Claude measures function timing, endpoint latency, or memory usage first, then reads profiler output to identify the top 3 time-consuming functions. It applies one minimal change to the top bottleneck, measures improvement percentage, and repeats until performance goals are met.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to improve speed, reduce latency, fix memory leaks, find bottlenecks, or optimize a slow function or endpoint.

say_en.text: Profile the performance of this Python function.
say_en.note: Claude will run a profiler and suggest optimizations.

say_en.text: Optimize this API endpoint to reduce P99 latency.
say_en.note: Claude will measure latency and propose a fix.

say_en.text: Find memory leaks in this code.
say_en.note: Claude will record heap usage and analyze.
